```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
if (!exists("params") || !is.list(params)) params <- list(preset = "spikein", seed9_full = TRUE)
```

# Question

The si3d hypoxia 1hr **intrinsic regression** - a random forest predicting each gene's TE change
(log2 sictrl / si3d) from sequence features alone, with GC split into GC1/GC2/GC3 and the
aggregate `cds_gc` / `transcript_gc` removed - is fit twice:

| arm | outcome |
|---|---|
| `spike` | `translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv` (spike-in size factors) |
| `nospike` | `translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr_nospike.csv` (standard DESeq2 median-of-ratios), built and checked by `spikein_literature_comparison/05_` |

Everything else is identical: genes, features, forest settings, and - because `nospike` sets
`split_strata_csv` to the spike-in file - **the train/test split at every `split_seed`**. So the
comparison is **paired**: at each of the 20 splits both arms are trained and tested on the same
genes, and any difference is the outcome.

Two things this cannot separate: the forest seed is shared but the trees differ because y
differs (inherent), and SHAP is computed on 200 held-out genes per split, the same 200 in both
arms.

**How a difference is judged.** Each quantity has a split-to-split spread *within* an arm - what
it moves by when only the held-out genes change. A spike vs no-spike difference counts only if
it is (1) consistent in sign across the paired splits and (2) large relative to that spread.
One split is never enough: at seed 9 alone, held-out Spearman and 5-fold CV Spearman disagree on
which arm is better.

```{r libs}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(here) })
library(dplyr)
src <- here("code", "translational_control_overview")
source(file.path(src, "02_sweep_presets.R"))
source(file.path(src, "10_regression_presets.R"))
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
arms  <- REG_PRESETS[[params$preset]]
stopifnot("preset must have exactly the spike and nospike arms" =
            setequal(names(arms), c("spike", "nospike")))
seeds <- REG_SPLIT_SEEDS
arm_cols <- c(spike = "#E69F00", nospike = "#87610e")   # 05_'s spike / no-spike fills
fpath <- function(stem, arm, s) file.path(O, paste0(stem, reg_suffix(arms[[arm]], s), ".csv"))
```

# 1. The two outcomes

```{r outcomes}
pred1 <- map(names(arms), ~ read_csv(fpath("rfreg_predictions_", .x, seeds[1]), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
               dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol, y, split)) %>% set_names(names(arms))
yy <- inner_join(pred1$spike, pred1$nospike, by = c("gene_id_clean", "symbol"),
                 suffix = c("_spike", "_nospike"))
stopifnot("the arms model different genes" =
            nrow(yy) == nrow(pred1$spike) && nrow(yy) == nrow(pred1$nospike))
tibble(n_genes = nrow(yy),
       median_spike = median(yy$y_spike), median_nospike = median(yy$y_nospike),
       sd_spike = sd(yy$y_spike), sd_nospike = sd(yy$y_nospike),
       spearman = cor(yy$y_spike, yy$y_nospike, method = "spearman"),
       pearson = cor(yy$y_spike, yy$y_nospike)) %>% print(width = Inf)
```

A constant shift does not change what a forest learns (it splits on variance). What can change
the model is the part of the outcome the two do **not** share - here 1 - rho^2 of the ranks.

```{r outcome_scatter, fig.width=4.5, fig.height=4.2}
ggplot(yy, aes(y_spike, y_nospike)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 70) + scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10") +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, 2), ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
  labs(x = "TE log2FC, spike-in", y = "TE log2FC, no spike-in",
       title = "Modelled genes", fill = "genes",
       subtitle = sprintf("Spearman = %.3f, n = %d",
                          cor(yy$y_spike, yy$y_nospike, method = "spearman"), nrow(yy))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```

# 2. Performance, paired over 20 splits

```{r perf_load}
read_perf <- function(arm, s) {
  f <- fpath("rfreg_performance_", arm, s)
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(arm = arm, seed = s)
}
perf <- map_dfr(names(arms), function(a) map_dfr(seeds, ~ read_perf(a, .x)))
n_have <- perf %>% distinct(arm, seed) %>% dplyr::count(arm)
print(n_have)
stopifnot("a sweep arm is incomplete - rerun 11d_shap_regression_seed_sweep.R spikein" =
            all(n_have$n == length(seeds)))

# The splits must actually be paired, not merely seeded alike.
for (s in seeds) {
  a <- read_csv(fpath("rfreg_predictions_", "spike", s), show_col_types = FALSE)
  b <- read_csv(fpath("rfreg_predictions_", "nospike", s), show_col_types = FALSE)
  j <- inner_join(a, b, by = "gene_id_clean")
  stopifnot("train/test split differs between arms - the comparison is not paired" =
              nrow(j) == nrow(a) && all(j$split.x == j$split.y))
}
cat("All", length(seeds), "splits are identical between arms.\n")
```

`r2_var_explained_trained_scale` is relative to each outcome's own variance, and Spearman is
free of scale altogether, so both are comparable across arms. RMSE is not (the outcomes have
different spreads) and is left out.

```{r perf_paired}
metrics <- c(spearman_raw_y = "held-out Spearman", pearson_raw_y = "held-out Pearson",
             r2_var_explained_trained_scale = "held-out R2", oob_r2 = "out-of-bag R2")
pw <- perf %>% filter(metric %in% names(metrics)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(diff = nospike - spike)
perf_tbl <- pw %>% group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(median_spike = median(spike), median_nospike = median(nospike),
            sd_spike = sd(spike), sd_nospike = sd(nospike),
            median_diff = median(diff), sd_diff = sd(diff),
            q05_diff = quantile(diff, 0.05), q95_diff = quantile(diff, 0.95),
            nospike_higher = sum(diff > 0),
            p_wilcoxon = wilcox.test(diff, exact = FALSE)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = metrics[metric],
         # how big the paired gap is next to the split-to-split spread of the metric itself
         diff_over_split_sd = median_diff / pmax(sd_spike, sd_nospike))
print(perf_tbl, width = Inf)
write_csv(perf_tbl, file.path(O, "spikein_comparison_performance.csv"))
```

## Figure: R2 and rho2

Held-out R2 is the fraction of each outcome's variance the model explains; rho2 is the squared
Spearman correlation between predicted and observed TE on held-out genes (rank-based, so blind to
the spike-in shift by construction). Lines join the two arms at the same split. The right panel
is the paired difference: the arm gap with the split-to-split noise cancelled.

```{r fig_r2_rho2, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.6}
rr <- perf %>% filter(metric %in% c("r2_var_explained_trained_scale", "spearman_raw_y")) %>%
  mutate(value = if_else(metric == "spearman_raw_y", value^2, value),
         metric = recode(metric, r2_var_explained_trained_scale = "R2",
                         spearman_raw_y = "rho2 (Spearman squared)")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(diff = nospike - spike)
rr_long <- rr %>% pivot_longer(c(spike, nospike), names_to = "arm") %>%
  mutate(arm = factor(arm, levels = c("spike", "nospike"), labels = c("Spike-in", "No spike-in")))
rr_sum <- rr %>% group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(lab = sprintf("median %.3f vs %.3f\ndiff %+.3f, %d/%d splits higher\nWilcoxon p = %.2g",
                          median(spike), median(nospike), median(diff), sum(diff > 0), n(),
                          wilcox.test(diff, exact = FALSE)$p.value), .groups = "drop")
p1 <- ggplot(rr_long, aes(arm, value)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = seed), colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = arm), size = 1.8) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.4, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(arm_cols), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_text(data = rr_sum, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.6) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "held-out value") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
p2 <- ggplot(rr, aes(metric, diff)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, size = 1.6, colour = "grey30") +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.4, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("R2" = "R2", "rho2 (Spearman squared)" = "rho2")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "no spike-in minus spike-in") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
p_rr <- cowplot::plot_grid(p1, p2, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(2.3, 1))
p_rr <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_label(
    sprintf("si3d hypoxia 1hr intrinsic regression: spike-in vs no spike-in (n = %d paired splits, %d genes)",
            length(seeds), nrow(yy)), size = 11, fontface = "bold"),
  p_rr, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1))
print(p_rr)
ggsave(here("plots", "51_spikein_r2_rho2_paired.pdf"), p_rr, width = 9, height = 3.6)
```

```{r perf_plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.3}
pl <- pw %>% mutate(metric = factor(metrics[metric], levels = metrics)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(spike, nospike), names_to = "arm") %>%
  mutate(arm = factor(arm, levels = c("spike", "nospike")))
ggplot(pl, aes(arm, value)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = seed), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = arm), size = 1.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = arm_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(spike = "Spike-in", nospike = "No spike-in")) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Paired by split (lines join the same split)",
       subtitle = sprintf("n = %d splits, %d genes each", length(seeds), nrow(yy))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
ggsave(here("plots", "51_spikein_performance_paired.pdf"), width = 9, height = 3.3)
```

# 3. SHAP by feature family, paired over 20 splits

SHAP is additive, so a family's share is exact. Shares are in percent of total |SHAP| within an
arm, which removes the difference in outcome scale between the arms.

**The floor.** The within-arm spread of a family's share across splits is what it moves by for
free. A family is called different only if the paired difference has the same sign in at least
18 of 20 splits **and** its median exceeds 2.8 x the larger within-arm sd (the min-detectable
convention in CLAUDE.md, measured here on this model rather than borrowed from the classifier).

```{r shap_family}
fam <- map_dfr(names(arms), function(a) map_dfr(seeds, function(s) {
  f <- fpath("shapreg_family_", a, s)
  stopifnot("SHAP family file missing - the sweep did not finish" = file.exists(f))
  read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(arm = a, seed = s)
}))
fw <- fam %>% dplyr::select(family, arm, seed, share_pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = share_pct) %>%
  mutate(diff = nospike - spike)
fam_tbl <- fw %>% group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(median_spike = median(spike), median_nospike = median(nospike),
            sd_spike = sd(spike), sd_nospike = sd(nospike),
            median_diff = median(diff), q05_diff = quantile(diff, 0.05),
            q95_diff = quantile(diff, 0.95),
            same_sign = max(sum(diff > 0), sum(diff < 0)),
            min_detectable = 2.8 * max(sd_spike, sd_nospike),
            p_wilcoxon = wilcox.test(diff, exact = FALSE)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(call = if_else(same_sign >= 18 & abs(median_diff) > min_detectable,
                        "DIFFERS", "within floor")) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_spike))
print(fam_tbl, width = Inf)
write_csv(fam_tbl, file.path(O, "spikein_comparison_shap_family.csv"))
```

```{r shap_family_plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
fo <- fam_tbl$family
fp <- fw %>% pivot_longer(c(spike, nospike), names_to = "arm", values_to = "share") %>%
  mutate(family = factor(family, levels = rev(fo)),
         arm = factor(arm, levels = c("spike", "nospike"), labels = c("Spike-in", "No spike-in")))
ggplot(fp, aes(share, family, colour = arm)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", shape = 124, size = 6,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(arm_cols)) +
  labs(x = "share of total |SHAP| (%)", y = NULL, colour = NULL,
       title = "Family SHAP share per split",
       subtitle = sprintf("n = %d splits x 200 held-out genes; bar = median", length(seeds))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(here("plots", "51_spikein_shap_family_share.pdf"), width = 8, height = 5)
```

# 4. Individual features: share, rank and direction

`shap_value_cor` - the correlation between a feature's value and its own SHAP value - is the
directional quantity. A feature is **sign-unstable** within an arm if fewer than 18 of 20 splits
agree on its sign; its direction is not interpretable in that arm, so a between-arm "flip" is
only called for features that are sign-stable in both.

```{r shap_feature}
feat <- map_dfr(names(arms), function(a) map_dfr(seeds, function(s)
  read_csv(fpath("shapreg_feature_", a, s), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(arm = a, seed = s)))
feat_tbl <- feat %>% group_by(feature, family, arm) %>%
  summarise(share = median(share_pct), rank = median(rank_shap),
            n_pos = sum(shap_value_cor > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_neg = sum(shap_value_cor < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            cor = median(shap_value_cor, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(sign_stable = pmax(n_pos, n_neg) >= 18,
         direction = case_when(!sign_stable ~ "unstable", n_pos > n_neg ~ "+", TRUE ~ "-")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = c(share, rank, cor, direction, sign_stable)) %>%
  left_join(feat %>% dplyr::select(feature, arm, seed, share_pct) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = share_pct) %>%
              group_by(feature) %>%
              summarise(median_share_diff = median(nospike - spike),
                        share_same_sign = max(sum(nospike > spike), sum(nospike < spike)),
                        sd_within = max(sd(spike), sd(nospike)), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "feature") %>%
  mutate(rank_change = rank_nospike - rank_spike,
         direction_flip = sign_stable_spike & sign_stable_nospike &
                          direction_spike != direction_nospike,
         share_call = if_else(share_same_sign >= 18 & abs(median_share_diff) > 2.8 * sd_within,
                              "DIFFERS", "within floor")) %>%
  arrange(rank_spike)
feat_tbl %>% dplyr::select(feature, family, share_spike, share_nospike, rank_spike, rank_nospike,
                           cor_spike, cor_nospike, direction_spike, direction_nospike,
                           share_call, direction_flip) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>% print(n = 25, width = Inf)
write_csv(feat_tbl, file.path(O, "spikein_comparison_shap_feature.csv"))

cat("\nFeatures whose share differs beyond the floor:",
    paste(feat_tbl$feature[feat_tbl$share_call == "DIFFERS"], collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Sign-stable in both arms but with opposite direction:",
    paste(feat_tbl$feature[feat_tbl$direction_flip %in% TRUE], collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Sign-unstable in exactly one arm:",
    paste(feat_tbl$feature[xor(feat_tbl$sign_stable_spike, feat_tbl$sign_stable_nospike)],
          collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## Figure: top-15 feature SHAP importance

The union of each arm's top 15 features by median SHAP share, ordered by the spike-in arm. Bars
are the median share across the 20 splits, whiskers the 5-95% range across splits - the noise
any difference has to clear. `*` marks a feature whose share differs beyond the floor (same sign
in >= 18/20 paired splits and |median difference| > 2.8 x within-arm sd); the arrow after the
name is its direction (`+` = higher value pushes predicted TE up, from `shap_value_cor`), `?`
where the direction is sign-unstable, shown spike-in / no spike-in.

```{r fig_top15, fig.width=8, fig.height=6.5}
top15 <- union(feat_tbl %>% arrange(rank_spike) %>% head(15) %>% pull(feature),
               feat_tbl %>% arrange(rank_nospike) %>% head(15) %>% pull(feature))
t15 <- feat %>% filter(feature %in% top15) %>%
  group_by(feature, arm) %>%
  summarise(med = median(share_pct), lo = quantile(share_pct, 0.05),
            hi = quantile(share_pct, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(feat_tbl %>% dplyr::select(feature, share_call, direction_spike, direction_nospike,
                                       rank_spike), by = "feature") %>%
  mutate(lab = paste0(feature, if_else(share_call == "DIFFERS", " *", ""), "  (",
                      recode(direction_spike, unstable = "?"), " / ",
                      recode(direction_nospike, unstable = "?"), ")"))
ord <- t15 %>% filter(arm == "spike") %>% arrange(desc(med)) %>% pull(lab)
t15 <- t15 %>% mutate(lab = factor(lab, levels = rev(ord)),
                      arm = factor(arm, levels = c("nospike", "spike"),
                                   labels = c("No spike-in", "Spike-in")))
p_t15 <- ggplot(t15, aes(med, lab, fill = arm)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
                 height = 0.25, linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Spike-in" = "#E69F00", "No spike-in" = "#87610e"),
                    breaks = c("Spike-in", "No spike-in")) +
  labs(x = "share of total |SHAP| (%), median over splits", y = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Top-15 features by SHAP: spike-in vs no spike-in",
       subtitle = sprintf("n = %d splits x 200 held-out genes; whiskers 5-95%% across splits; * differs beyond floor",
                          length(seeds))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
print(p_t15)
ggsave(here("plots", "51_spikein_top15_shap.pdf"), p_t15, width = 8, height = 6.5)
```

**Top-20 agreement.** Jaccard of the top-20 SHAP features between the two arms at the same split,
against the same quantity between two splits of one arm - the latter is how much the top 20 moves
for free.

```{r top20}
top20 <- feat %>% filter(rank_shap <= 20) %>% group_by(arm, seed) %>%
  summarise(f = list(feature), .groups = "drop")
jac <- function(a, b) length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
between <- map_dbl(seeds, function(s)
  jac(top20$f[top20$arm == "spike" & top20$seed == s][[1]],
      top20$f[top20$arm == "nospike" & top20$seed == s][[1]]))
within <- map_dfr(names(arms), function(a) {
  ff <- top20$f[top20$arm == a]
  pr <- combn(length(ff), 2)
  tibble(arm = a, j = map_dbl(seq_len(ncol(pr)), ~ jac(ff[[pr[1, .x]]], ff[[pr[2, .x]]])))
})
top20_tbl <- bind_rows(
  tibble(comparison = "spike vs no-spike, same split", median = median(between),
         min = min(between), max = max(between), n = length(between)),
  within %>% group_by(arm) %>%
    summarise(median = median(j), min = min(j), max = max(j), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    transmute(comparison = paste0(arm, ": split vs split"), median, min, max, n))
print(top20_tbl)
write_csv(top20_tbl, file.path(O, "spikein_comparison_top20_jaccard.csv"))
```

# 5. Per gene (seed 9, full run)

Sweep mode skips the per-gene table, so this uses the full seed-9 run of each arm. Same split,
same 200 explained genes - asserted, not assumed.

```{r per_gene, eval = isTRUE(params$seed9_full)}
pg <- map(names(arms), ~ read_csv(fpath("shapreg_per_gene_", .x, 9L), show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  set_names(names(arms))
stopifnot("the two seed-9 runs explained different genes" =
            identical(pg$spike$gene_id_clean, pg$nospike$gene_id_clean))
fc <- intersect(setdiff(names(pg$spike), c("gene_id_clean", "symbol", "y", "pred")),
                names(pg$nospike))
A <- as.matrix(pg$spike[, fc]); B <- as.matrix(pg$nospike[, fc])
# Scale each arm's SHAP by its own total so the outcome-scale difference does not enter.
A <- A / mean(rowSums(abs(A))); B <- B / mean(rowSums(abs(B)))
gene_r <- map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(A)), ~ cor(A[.x, ], B[.x, ]))
feat_r <- map_dbl(seq_along(fc), ~ suppressWarnings(cor(A[, .x], B[, .x])))
cat(sprintf("Per gene: correlation of the %d-feature SHAP profile between arms, median %.3f (5-95%%: %.3f to %.3f), n = %d genes\n",
            length(fc), median(gene_r), quantile(gene_r, .05), quantile(gene_r, .95), length(gene_r)))
top_f <- feat_tbl$feature[1:15]
tibble(feature = fc, r = feat_r) %>% filter(feature %in% top_f) %>%
  arrange(match(feature, top_f)) %>% mutate(r = round(r, 3)) %>% print(n = Inf)
```

```{r per_gene_plot, eval = isTRUE(params$seed9_full), fig.width=4.5, fig.height=3.2}
ggplot(tibble(r = gene_r), aes(r)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey60", colour = "white") +
  labs(x = "Pearson r, spike vs no-spike SHAP profile", y = "genes",
       title = "Per-gene SHAP agreement (seed 9)",
       subtitle = sprintf("n = %d held-out genes, %d features", length(gene_r), length(fc))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
ggsave(here("plots", "51_spikein_per_gene_shap_agreement.pdf"), width = 4.5, height = 3.2)
```
